purpose: Audit the original eight-part hill-climb objective at campaign scope. Preserve its full scope, failed trials, per-metric tradeoffs and permissible bounded-plateau conclusion. This plan neither declares completion nor authorizes a new inference experiment or rejected-policy retuning.

test_selection.changed: Every existing tests/unit/test_*.py path in git diff --name-only a14a24cd..de89fd84, without selecting by prior result or expected pass status.
test_selection.execution: Deduplicate and sort the complete selected file set. Use a new detached Git worktree at the declared revision, clean committed fixtures and the original three CPU shared libraries matching the retained controls. Verify all selected test and production source bytes against the frozen Git tree and libraries against original pins before/after tests. Do not run tests in the dirty primary samples directory or alter old scientific snapshots.
test_selection.failures: Preserve failures, errors and skips with reasons and exact original test selection. Diagnose actual failures before deciding whether a scoped fix is needed. Never omit a failing file or count a skipped native check as a pass. A positive test result alone is not campaign completion.

original_requirements.requirement: Continue original membership work and close QfO/Three Kingdoms evaluations without duplicates.
original_requirements.evidence: Read original round1 plan and runner, current terminal array/supplement accounting, admitted cells and preserved failed/unavailable attempts; verify that final vectors trace to matching controls/recoveries.

original_requirements.requirement: Diagnose fresh HMM candidate loss and investigate broader families with duplication-aware splitting and satellite retention.
original_requirements.evidence: Read candidate-cap, ranking/k-mer/significance and fresh-union diagnostics, whole-pipeline negative pilots, copy-branch/component/retention plans and results, and candidate-to-final localization. Distinguish fresh search from cached graph experiments and stage association from causal proof.

original_requirements.requirement: Bounded precommitted rounds, immutable controls and opt-in changes.
original_requirements.evidence: Trace each of the ten ledger groups to committed plans, source/launch/admission identities and explicit gates. Read production changes and default compatibility/context/checkpoint tests. Retain historical baseline data and unsuccessful configurations; no default promotion based on mixed point gains.

original_requirements.requirement: Eight separate endpoints, full comparator panel, validated native outputs and diagnostic/resource fields.
original_requirements.evidence: Authenticate the v27 chain, retained comparator registry and experiment admissions; crosscheck every endpoint/NA/completeness flag and failure lineage. Inspect precision/recall, coverage, pairs and resource availability/scopes rather than infer them from F1. Check control reproduction and scoring/identifier semantics, including OrthoFinder 3.1.5 full and sequence-only outputs. Preserve truly missing historical fields explicitly.

original_requirements.requirement: Protect scientific validity and seek feasible unexposed confirmation.
original_requirements.evidence: Inspect acquisition/overlap reviews, family-resampling readouts and limits, GO/EC population diagnostics and retained FAS sampling evidence. Keep all examined panels development-exposed, TreeFam supporting and missing archives nonblocking; no invented VGNC/GO/EC uncertainty or unsupported FAS gain claim.

original_requirements.requirement: Bounded local Threadripper resources and honest timing.
original_requirements.evidence: Inspect original allocation/host records and separate cached, failed, recovered, scoring, conversion and fresh-run costs. Do not require the DGX or a quiet window, stop unrelated jobs, sum incomparable memory scopes or infer isolated speed advantages.

original_requirements.requirement: Focused regression tests, scoped commits and pushes.
original_requirements.evidence: Consolidated frozen test selection plus actual policy/HMM/phylogeny fixture evidence; inspect tests for deterministic behavior, default compatibility, gene ownership, CLI/API guards, checkpoint validity and edge cases. Verify selected changes are committed/pushed and unrelated user files remain untouched.

original_requirements.requirement: Reproducible ledger, separate-metric comparison, recommendation and honest conclusion.
original_requirements.evidence: Finalize the complete ledger/table and default recommendation with pointers to verified evidence, failed arms, uncertainty, resource limitations and defensible next experiments. A bounded plateau is acceptable only after the original work is audited; no universal OrthoFinder victory, per-dataset winner composite or narrowed success criterion.

completion_rule: For each explicit objective requirement and referenced plan/gate, record whether current authoritative evidence proves it, contradicts it, shows incomplete work, or is missing/too indirect. Only mark the active goal complete if the full original objective and deliverables are proved, including an honest supported plateau when appropriate. Otherwise continue concrete remaining work; do not relabel missing evidence as completion or an external blocker.
git: Commit/push this audit plan, consolidated regression evidence and any validated findings/recommendation at scoped milestones. Never blanket-stage or revert unrelated dirty samples.
